caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest composed of a rectangular box with a flat top, rendered in light to medium brown tones to represent the wood grain. The front face of the chest features a large, plain panel, with a small, triangular, golden-colored lock plate centered near the top edge. Below the main panel, there is a single, spacious drawer spanning almost the entire width of the chest, equipped with two small round wooden knobs, one on each side. The left side of the chest is shaded to indicate depth and dimension, while the chest sits on a blank, off-white background. The overall composition is simple, with no additional objects or decorations present within the scene.
title: Shaker Chest
